verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a SaaS remote-desktop service with accounts and audit logs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents user- or admin-controlled retention settings or data deletion. 'Audit logs (last 7 days)' describes a fixed log window, not a retention control. 'Privacy mode' and peer-to-peer routing are adjacent privacy features and do not address retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
